senses.definition: A device for moving or compressing a liquid or gas.
examples: This pump can deliver 100 gallons of water per minute.

senses.definition: An instance of the action of a pump; one stroke of a pump; any action similar to pumping
examples: It takes thirty pumps to get 10 litres; he did 50 pumps of the weights.

senses.definition: A device for dispensing liquid or gas to be sold, particularly fuel; a gas pump.
examples: This pump is out of order, but you can gas up at the next one.
